name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 👑 Queen ages: each hive's page shows how old its queen is. Started as a cell or a virgin, it's in months; a bought queen shows her year and how long she's been in that hive.
👑 Hives › All my queens and their ages: oldest first, with Getting old, Year unknown and Queenless. Type the age you call getting old (2 years until you change it).
🔔 Pick the sound for your turn to answer: ⚙️ Settings › 🎙️ Listening › The sound. Tap one to hear it.
🐝 A new Hives picture in the menu, menu pictures in full color, and the one you're on is shaded.
🤔 What am I looking at? in an inspection: what to look for in each box, or describe what you see to get what it most likely is, what to do, and photos.
▾ Every dropdown is the app's own list, right under the box.
🏠 Home's hive list: pick All yards or one yard. Filter and sort buttons say what they do.
📋 Club officers: bring in the club's member sheet your way. Pick where each column goes, or make a club field for it.
📱 Older phones: hives drag on the yard map again, and Buddy hears better on them.
